name: The Two Sides of Love
source:
In "The Two Sides of Love", you play as a former boxer who has lost everything, especially the people closest to him, after being accused of being a drug addict and alcoholic. Your ex-wife disappears, and that brings your daughters back into your life, but where is she? You will have to investigate who this strange nightmare subject is while trying to win back the love of your daughters.​ 

[From F95Zone]
translation:
在《爱情的两面》中，你将扮演一名失去一切的前拳击手。别人指控他是瘾君子和酒鬼，害他失去了最亲近的人。前妻失踪后，两个女儿重新回到他的生活中，但她究竟在哪里？你必须调查这个奇怪梦魇的来历，同时努力重新赢得女儿们的爱。

[来源：F95Zone]
